TABLE.NAME: local_miwlab_restores
TABLE.COMMENT: Progress of the restores queued by the MiwLab. No data of a person.

FIELD.NAME: restoreid
FIELD.COMMENT: Public identifier of the restore

FIELD.NAME: categoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: Category of the new course

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The new course, once created; the course replaced, in mode replace

FIELD.NAME: mode
FIELD.COMMENT: new: a new course in the category; replace: the content of courseid replaced (1.5.0)

FIELD.NAME: marker
FIELD.COMMENT: MiwLab marker to write in the course ID number

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 queued, 1 running, 2 finished, 3 failed

FIELD.NAME: progress
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 to 1 while running

FIELD.NAME: backupfilename
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode replace: the backup made before, in the course backup area

FIELD.NAME: rolledback
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode replace: the restore failed after deleting content and the backup was restored

FIELD.NAME: expectedsignature
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode replace: the state of the course the MiwLab knew, checked again before replacing

FIELD.NAME: unchangedsince
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode replace: without the state, the course must not have been edited after this time

FIELD.NAME: forcediscard
FIELD.COMMENT: Mode replace: replace even if students have progress (1.7.3)

FIELD.NAME: topicscreated
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.7.0: forum topics recreated from the package after the restore

FIELD.NAME: topicsskipped
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.7.0: forum topics of the package that could not be created

FIELD.NAME: topicsnote
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.7.0: the first reason a topic was not created

FIELD.NAME: keepdays
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.9.0: days the full backup made before a discard is kept (30 to 365)

FIELD.NAME: fullbackup
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.9.0: the backup kept carries the people (made before a discard)

FIELD.NAME: backupexpires
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.9.0: when the full backup is deleted; 0 none

FIELD.NAME: updateresult
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.9.0 (mode update): what was done, item by item (JSON, no person)

FIELD.NAME: previewid
FIELD.COMMENT: 1.9.0 (mode update): the preview this run applies

TABLE.NAME: local_miwlab_updates
TABLE.COMMENT: Previews of the safe update of a course (1.9.0): the operations, what each one would do, and the state of the course. No person: counts only.

FIELD.NAME: previewid
FIELD.COMMENT: Public identifier of the preview

FIELD.NAME: accountid
FIELD.COMMENT: The account (of the integration) that asked; only it can apply

FIELD.NAME: signature
FIELD.COMMENT: State of the course content when previewed

FIELD.NAME: operations
FIELD.COMMENT: The operations, validated (JSON)

FIELD.NAME: items
FIELD.COMMENT: What each operation would do (JSON)

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 open, 1 applied (queued)

TABLE.NAME: local_miwlab_backups
TABLE.COMMENT: Content backups of courses made for the MiwLab (1.6.0), without any data of a person; the file is deleted once downloaded or after a day.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course backed up

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 queued, 1 running, 2 finished, 3 failed

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: The backup file, in the course context, area contentbackup, item = id

FIELD.NAME: secrethash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the secret returned once to the request that queued the backup; status, parts and deletion need it

TABLE.NAME: local_miwlab_fullcopies
TABLE.COMMENT: Full backups (with the people) made before a replacement that discards progress (1.9.0): which file in the course backup area and when it is deleted. No data of a person.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course backed up

FIELD.NAME: filename
FIELD.COMMENT: The file, in the course backup area of the course

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: Content hash of the file made: only this one is deleted

FIELD.NAME: timeexpires
FIELD.COMMENT: When the plugin deletes the file
